error[ZBX-E0212]: a --mount source is outside the project
  while  checking that --mount escape is inside the project
  cause  --mount escape is /etc, outside the project /home/alice/project; a
         writable mount stays inside it
  within /home/alice/project
  real   /etc
  fix    run zbx from the project's directory
         or give a directory elsewhere read-only:   zbx run --bind /path/to/dir:/dir <image>
  more   zbx explain E0212
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0212.html
